_note: User-facing display text, keyed by a stable id. This is the ONLY place wording lives (city display names are the one exception - they live in cities.json's own `name` field; see src/ui/strings.ts's header for why). src/ui/strings.ts's t()/facilityName() read through this table so that renaming the game's IP later is a data swap here, not a source sweep. Neutral/original wording only - no protected marks (see docs/SPEC.md). facility.*, refusal.* and event.* MUST cover every facilityKinds entry in cities.json, every refusalReasons entry in couriers.json, and every HudMessageKind in @/ui/hud - src/ui/strings.ts asserts that at module load and throws if a ruleset id is added here without matching wording.
